tools.name: search
tools.description: Find agents for a task. Returns agents with a nullable grounded overview, reasons and connectionPrompt, plus an optional plan, question or noMatchReason. Refine using previousResponseId and context. Retain searchToken for anonymous follow-ups and Search-to-Act handoff. Search never executes work.

tools.name: show_darwin_view
tools.description: Optional read-only digest: agents from the exact Search presentation token, or a current owner-bound thread approval, authentication request, payment terms, or output. Never use for clarification, no-match, ordinary chat, progress or acknowledgements. No input form or execution. The assistant handle

tools.name: open_darwin
tools.description: Open the Darwin Browse app. Use search for a query and the thread tools for authorized interactions.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Start work from searchId or explicit targets, or continue a thread using threadId and a typed message. Authentication and payment responses use this tool. Preserve idempotencyKey on retries. Inspect get_thread for verified results; acceptance is not completion or settlement.

tools.name: start_thread
tools.description: Start a private thread and atomically send its first message. For a protected MCP target with exactly one tool, use action_request with capability private-mcp:default and that tool's arguments. Authenticated discovery must confirm one tool, and separate invocation review must approve the request.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Append one typed event to an authorized thread. Use message for ordinary text; action_request for one advertised capability; action_confirmation for the exact proposed external effect; approval_confirmation with decision allow or deny for one additional permission; completion_confirmation to accept

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a thread, optionally waiting for new events.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List private threads with simple target, attention and archive filters.

tools.name: archive_thread
tools.description: Archive a thread without cancelling its work.

tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Start hosted authentication for a thread request.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Open hosted selection for an immutable payment request.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the authenticated person’s safe Darwin account context and authorized AIs. Excludes email, phone, credentials, API keys, and application administration.

tools.name: list_search_history
tools.description: List the authenticated person’s recent Darwin searches with bounded pagination. History expires after 90 days and never includes another account’s searches.

tools.name: list_act_history
tools.description: List private threads for the authorized Darwin account. This is the same bounded read as list_threads.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List a cursor page of saved payment method references for the authorized account with status, rail and default selection. Continue with nextCursor as afterCursor until null. Returns safe IDs and labels only, never card numbers, bank details or provider instrument tokens. A saved method is not approv

tools.name: list_auth_credentials
tools.description: List a cursor page of saved connection metadata for the authorized account. Continue with nextCursor as afterCursor until null. Returns safe IDs and labels only, never passwords, tokens, API keys or credential values. Selecting a saved credential does not grant new permission.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, previousResponseId, forkSearchId, agentCount, maxResults, context, searchToken

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: show_darwin_view, open_darwin, get_thread, list_threads, get_account, list_act_history · Private data: show_darwin_view, start_thread, list_threads, get_account, list_act_history, list_payment_methods, list_auth_credentials · Public sink: start_thread, send_message, get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: show_darwin_view, open_darwin, get_thread, list_threads, get_account, list_act_history · Private data: show_darwin_view, start_thread, list_threads, get_account, list_act_history, list_payment_methods, list_auth_credentials · Public sink: start_thread, send_message, get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_darwin_capabilities" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
